== Summary ==
Original Japanese [[Tatooine: Mos Eisley (Dark) (Japanese Premiere Two-Player)|Tatooine: Mos Eisley (Dark)]] from [[Premiere Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]]. Card-face crop from [https://swccgcards.com/product/jpn-premiere-wb-ds-tatooine-mos-eisley/ SWCCGcards], [https://swccgcards.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/01/jpn_premiere_wb_ds_TATOOINE_MOS_EISLEY.png source photograph].

Crop rectangle <code>(8, 6, 843, 1194)</code> after applying the source orientation. Source SHA-256 <code>e43213748b0fe4112c1b2c43d144bd1fd2eb6b2fb8096d32250561c2b90194f1</code>. Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc., 1997.
